changes.lobby: Lobby: open a lobby, invite your friends online and look for a match from the PC or the phone.
changes.live: Your KDA, farm, gold and level live while you play, on the phone too.
changes.following: Following Xyra: how you do when you take the recommended card and when you do not.
changes.notify: The phone tells you when your game starts loading and when a patch changes your champions.
changes.history: Your games with each champion in Build, and the spells you used in History.

builtWith: Made with Rust, Tauri and Svelte. The in-game overlay is native: no browser, almost no memory.
